system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## REVIEW OF SELLER’S UPDATED SPA & DISCLOSURE LETTER  
**Project Kestrel – Buyer (Wattlebridge Holdings) Side**  
*Against internal playbook (baseline: 25%/AUD 6 M cap, 24-month general claim period, AUD 5 k de minimis / AUD 50 k first-dollar basket, fraud carve-outs, specific disclosure, independent title proof, Bluefen pre-Completion consent, Riverlark pay-off at Completion, DD-005 bonuses in funds flow, broadened Ironquay indemnity, DD-006 investigation rights, Sandbar assessment, Tax/IP open, no “standard” pre-acceptance).*

---

### 1. GENERAL WARRANTY CAP – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| 20% / AUD 4.8 M (Clause 12.1) | 25% / AUD 6 M starting; 20% only with **written Amelia Frost authority** (none given) | **Unapproved fallback cap**. Seller treats 20% as “standard” and “final”. We have no principal sign-off. Must push to 25% / AUD 6 M. |

---

### 2. THRESHOLDS – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| De minimis AUD 25 k; basket AUD 250 k, **excess-only** recovery (Clause 12.2) | De minimis AUD 5 k; basket AUD 50 k, **first-dollar** recovery once exceeded | Seller’s thresholds are **5× and 5×** ours, and “excess-only” shifts AUD 250 k of risk to Buyer. Reject outright. |

---

### 3. TIME LIMITS & FUNDAMENTAL/TITLE REGIME – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| General claims: 18 months; “any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise” (Clauses 12.3/13). Fundamental/Title: **same caps & time limits as general** for “administrative simplicity”. | General: **24 months** (18 months only with Amelia Frost approval – none). Fundamental/Title: **separate regime – 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar**. | Seller collapses the two regimes and shortens the period. **Unacceptable**. Title/capacity must sit outside general cap, basket, de minimis, knowledge qualifiers, and have a 6-year+ window. |

---

### 4. FRAUD / WILFUL CONCEALMENT / DELIBERATE MISCONDUCT – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Limitations, exclusive-remedy, non-reliance apply to **“all Claims of any nature”** (Clauses 9.3/12.8/20.5). | **Carved out of all caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance** to maximum enforceable extent. No one may waive. | Seller’s drafting **expressly includes fraud** in the limitation package. Must insert explicit carve-out. |

---

### 5. DISCLOSURE – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers** (Disclosure Letter §§1.1–1.2). | **Specific fair disclosure only**; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure. | Seller’s “general disclosure” is the **antithesis** of our position. Must require specific, document-by-document, paragraph-referenced disclosure. |

---

### 6. BUYER KNOWLEDGE – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| **Blanket exclusion**: no claim for any matter Buyer or advisers “had knowledge”, including matters “discoverable from the data room or public records” (Clause 8.3). | **Delete blanket exclusions**; any knowledge qualifier requires **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**; never excuses title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity. | Seller’s clause **swallows title, capacity, fraud, and specific indemnities** and imposes a constructive-knowledge standard on Buyer. Must redline heavily. |

---

### 7. BLUEFEN CONSENT – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| “Reasonable endeavours”; consent **treated as satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent** (Clauses 3/6.3). Disclosure Letter §2 confirms **no final written consent or evidence conditions satisfied**. | **Effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied BEFORE Completion**; consent-on-delivery insufficient; reasonable endeavours alone insufficient for material customer. | Seller has **not delivered** the consent, yet wants the condition deemed satisfied on mere delivery. Must make consent a **hard condition precedent** with documented satisfaction of all clause 11.3 conditions. |

---

### 8. RIVERLARK FACILITY – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Release **to be provided following Completion** (Clauses 2/7). Disclosure Letter §3: facility **not repaid, no final discharge**. | **Current payout + direct repayment from Completion funds + effective security releases**; post-Completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval**. | Seller leaves ~AUD 3.2 M debt outstanding at Completion with only a promise of future release. **Unacceptable**. Must be paid out at Completion from purchase price. |

---

### 9. EMPLOYEE BONUSES (DD-005) – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| AUD 420 k conditional Completion bonuses **“not separately itemised in the funds flow”**; “matter for the Seller”. No mention of payroll tax/super/on-costs. | **Specific line item or Seller-funded**; funds flow must **not silently exclude** AUD 420 k + triggered on-costs. | Seller is **hiding the liability** in the funds flow. Must appear as a discrete deduction or Seller indemnity. On-costs must be quantified and covered. |

---

### 10. IRONQUAY IP INDEMNITY – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Existing indemnity **limited to SOW3 payment only**; “considered adequate” (Clause 11.1). Disclosure Letter §4: AUD 180 k open, **no independent bank verification of payment**, no receipt/assignment in data room. | **Broaden narrow indemnity**, preserve SOW3 cure; AUD 180 k **not independently verified either way**. | Seller’s indemnity is too narrow and the payment status is **unverified**. Need broader IP ownership/non-infringement indemnity + proof of SOW3 fee payment or holdback. |

---

### 11. EXPORT/PRIVACY INCIDENT (DD-006) – **GAP IN PROTECTION**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Characterised as “preliminary operational matter not expected to be material” (Clause 4.6/Schedule 6). Disclosure Letter §6: investigation preliminary, **no confirmed breach, scope, access, or notification duty established**. | **Preserve logs, investigate, require updates**; assume **NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty, or numeric demand**. | Seller’s “not expected to be material” is a **premature legal conclusion**. We need: (a) specific indemnity for any regulatory fines/notification costs, (b) ongoing investigation covenant, (c) log preservation, (d) right to update Disclosure Letter pre-Completion. |

---

### 12. SANDBAR RENEWALS (AUD 330 k) – **ALIGNED BUT NEEDS LOCK-IN**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| “Ordinary-course operating costs” (Disclosure Letter §8). | Assess; **no automatic Debt classification or price deduction**. | Substantively aligned, but must ensure they are **not re-characterised as Debt** in the price-mechanics schedule. Confirm in drafting. |

---

### 13. TAX & IP WARRANTIES – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| “Considers tax and IP warranty positions settled under the general regime above.” | **Tax/IP terms remain OPEN**; assume **no unlimited liability and no resolution**; keep categories **separate**; no hidden general-regime override. | Seller tries to **fold Tax/IP into the 20% cap, 18-month period, basket, knowledge bar**. Must keep **separate, uncapped (or higher-capped), longer limitation** regimes for Tax and fundamental IP warranties. |

---

### 14. TITLE EVIDENCE – **MATERIAL DEPARTURE**
| Seller | Playbook | Gap |
|--------|----------|-----|
| Title evidenced by **Company share register at DD-012** (Disclosure Letter §10). | **Independent title/ownership/encumbrance/authority evidence**; DD-012 is **internal source, not independent proof**. | Seller offers only its own register. Need **ASIC search, beneficial ownership chain, no encumbrance certificates, power-of-attorney/board resolutions** as independent evidence. |

---

### 15. “STANDARD” LABEL & PRE-ACCEPTANCE TACTIC – **PROCESS ISSUE**
Seller marks core limitation/disclosure/knowledge clauses
=== END ADVICE ===
